finding.legacy_historical_model: The V2A historical strategy uses a current-universe reconstruction and therefore retains survivorship bias. That negative evidence remains true and immutable.
finding.prospective_epoch: The replacement Dataset Epoch is forward-only. Each daily run archives the universe bytes observed at that run, with source_run_utc, immutable hashes and retrospective_reconstruction=false. That contemporaneously observed membership is point-in-time evidence for future outcomes and is not a retrospective survivor reconstruction.
finding.latent_bug: tools/gate_btc_v2a_data_ledger.py currently copies the historical-model survivorship warning into the prospective point-in-time snapshot/status as survivorship_bias_present=true, while simultaneously labeling the record FUTURE_POINT_IN_TIME_UNIVERSE_AND_DATA_QUALITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY. The cutover gate then interprets that legacy flag as a prospective-PIT failure, making the authorized forward-only epoch impossible even when contemporaneous membership is archived correctly.

future_snapshot_fields.historical_model_survivorship_bias_prese: copy the legacy historical quality warning

frozen_resolution.prospective_false_requirement: prospective_point_in_time_universe_bias_present must be false only when the universe archive is captured in the same forward run, source_run_utc is present, retrospective_reconstruction=false, and immutable universe archive/hash metadata are present
frozen_resolution.cutover_behavior: For post-change snapshots, the cutover gate evaluates the explicit prospective PIT field and separately preserves/reports historical_model_survivorship_bias_present. Legacy snapshots without the explicit prospective field continue to fail closed and cannot be reinterpreted into D0.

why_not_methodology_change: The replacement epoch was already explicitly authorized as forward-only and the runtime ledger already archives contemporaneous universe bytes for future point-in-time evidence. This reconciliation separates two evidence domains that the implementation incorrectly collapsed; it does not alter selection, universe membership, source QA, completeness, thresholds, clocks, economics or historical conclusions.
